commit.subject: lane: enforce check-tests output boundaries
commit.body:
Reject contradictory empty changes envelopes, replace findings payload symlinks without following them, recognize write-path prompts by shape, and document the practiced read-job slots.

Source: original
Co-Authored-By: GPT-5.6 Sol <noreply@openai.com>
